limitations: Dissolved homogeneous Michaelis-Menten kinetics with the source-fitted diprotic pH dependence of kcat and Km; pH is read once from the environment.
This is an enzyme-kinetics case for recombinant BGL1A, not a whole-fungus growth, secretion, uptake, or wood-decay model.
The assay substrate and enzyme loadings are explicit exploratory assumptions because SABIO-RK entry 38522 records no concentrations; the case therefore runs in exploratory mode only.
Temperature is the 30 C set point of the source; no temperature response law is bound, so temperature stays metadata and cases at other temperatures cannot be ranked by temperature.
validity_notes: The pH law was fitted over pH 4-8 in four buffers (sodium acetate, MES, HEPES, EPPS); the bound pH-range roles make cases outside that range warn rather than fail.
The 2:1 glucose yield is reaction stoichiometry; the source reports initial rates, not product time courses.
